answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tide weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 35 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 87 times the capital for one share. The zenith report reveals the merge explicitly at each juniper. A farm of 1843 identities would post 644 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
